title: AAPS Release 3.4.2.1 - Equil driver not refresh battery and insulin reservouir status
body:
Hi

[AndroidAPS._2026-04-02_00-00-03_.2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26456131/AndroidAPS._2026-04-02_00-00-03_.2.zip)

I had an issue since version 3.4.0.0, that Equil driver doesn't refresh battery status as well insulin reservoir amount.In the meantime, I changed phones, installed AAPS on the new device, and imported my configuration. Surprisingly, both issues disappeared. Yesterday, I updated AAPS to the latest version (3.4.2.1), and unfortunately, the problem has returned.

Reporting bugs
--------------
- **Note the precise time the problem occurred** and describe the circumstances and steps that caused
  the problem
- Note the Build version (found in the About dialog in the app, when pressing the three dots in the
  upper-right corner).
- Obtain the app's log files, which can be found on the phone in
  _/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/info.nightscout.androidaps/_
  See https://wiki.aaps.app/en/latest/GettingHelp/AccessingLogFiles.html
- Open an issue at https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/new

comments.body: I was able to restore battery status and insulin reservoir amount refresh after i reset Bluetooth settings on android phone itself.
